_comment: Seed manifest for the shaarli held-out suite target (plan-005 U1, R1). Shaarli is the bookmarks archetype, a held-out instance distinct from the training target linkding. Seeding is live/docker-required (the generic SuiteTargetEnv drives Shaarli's REST API headlessly); the frozen suite slice's hand-verified verdicts are defined against THIS post-seed state, so changing it is a recorded apparatus migration, not an edit. Offline the manifest is shape-validated only.
